values.note: 17 'RV or Tent' sites with listed vehicle lengths 30-75 ft (most 40-57); 3 pull-throughs (40 and 75 ft), the rest back-in. 12 have a water hookup. The length counts the tow vehicle: 'Vehicle with camper attached must fit completely in the site'.

facilities.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/hurricane-lake-north-campground-blackwater-river-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120105 ('campsites with electric and water (potable), dump station, boat ramp, restrooms, and showers') + FDACS ('Restrooms and showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Florida Forest Service campground on its own ReserveAmerica site (or 1-877-879-3859): 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance' (window shown Oct 21 2026 to Sep 21 2027). All sites are site-specific; a campground host is on site. Cancelling 1 or more days before arrival costs a $9 non-refundable fee.

The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for people 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and the 100% disabled 'at applicable camping facilities'; documentation is registered by calling (877) 879-3859.

discounts.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/hurricane-lake-north-campground-blackwater-river-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120105 ('The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for individuals age 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and for individuals 100% disabled at applicable camping facilities'), read 2026-10-21

note: Florida Forest Service campground on the north side of 318-acre Hurricane Lake. Boat ramp. There are alligators in the lake: no swimming. Alcohol is prohibited. --Claude
